summary: Otis Worldwide Corp filed an 8-K reporting a $700 million debt issuance (4.488% Notes due 2029) via an underwritten public offering under its existing shelf registration. Net proceeds of ~$695.2 million will refinance maturing 0.318% Notes due Dec 2026 and repay commercial paper. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation — it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, or other enumerated special event. The interest rate and maturity terms are standard. There is no event-driven angle; the transaction merely extends the company's debt maturity profile.
